# splunkctl dashboards

Dashboard management.

## dashboards create

Create a dashboard from an XML or JSON file.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl dashboards create [OPTIONS]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--name` | text | - | Dashboard name. [required] |
| `--file` | path | - | XML or JSON file. [required] |
| `--app` | text | search | Splunk app context. |
| `--type` | choice: classic, studio, auto | auto |  |
| `--sharing` | choice: user, app, global | - | Set sharing level after creation. |

## dashboards delete

Delete a dashboard.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl dashboards delete [OPTIONS] NAME
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--app` | text | search | Splunk app context. |

## dashboards export

Export dashboard XML to file or stdout.

```text
splunkctl dashboards export [OPTIONS] [NAME]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--app` | text | - | Splunk app context. |
| `--out` | path | - | Output file (single dashboard). |
| `--definition` | flag | false | Extract Studio JSON definition. |
| `--all` | flag | false | Export all dashboards to --dir. |
| `--dir` | path | - | Directory for --all bulk export. |

## dashboards get

Get dashboard details including XML source.

```text
splunkctl dashboards get [OPTIONS] NAME
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--app` | text | - | Splunk app context. |
| `--definition` | flag | false | Extract Studio JSON definition (errors on classic). |

## dashboards list

List dashboards.

```text
splunkctl dashboards list [OPTIONS]
```

```text
--filter/--limit/--offset apply client-side, after the app and
dashboard-type row filters.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--app` | text | - | Only dashboards owned by this app. |
| `--all` | flag | false | Include non-dashboard views. |
| `--limit` | integer range | - | Return at most N entries (default: all). |
| `--offset` | integer range | 0 | Skip the first N entries. |
| `--filter` | text | - | Case-insensitive name substring; --limit/--offset then apply to the filtered set. |
